Markus / Emily — thanks, and excited to own this. A few clarifying items before we lock the kickoff agenda: 

1) Data residency & retention: we assume staging data will remain in US; Emily can you confirm maximum retention required for the pilot and any redaction needs? We need this to size log retention and S3 lifecycle policies.

2) Volume/Throughput: Markus flagged peak estimates — can you confirm expected concurrent sessions and average tokens per session for the pilot (est. monthly tokens helps us set batching/kv-cache defaults).

3) Model variant: are we starting on redwood-larger (recommended for accuracy) or a smaller quantized variant for cost? We should decide so we can pre-configure model bundles.

4) Access: please add tessa.morgan@redwood.ai as a read-only principal on the staging bucket (or share a presigned list) so we can validate ingestion during Sprint-0.

Internal ask to Monica/Karthik: please confirm availability for Jan 10-15 to ramp Dedicated capacity and smoke-test the cluster; if not feasible we should plan a short hosted-burst fallback for the pilot window.

I’ll draft a 30/60/90-day Sprint-0 runbook after the kickoff and circulate. Proposed kickoff: 2026-12-06 10:00 PT (Zoom link below).

Thanks Markus and Tessa — great to meet you both (virtually). A few responses: 

- Staging S3: I will share the staging S3 ARN and a restricted role for Redwood (arn:aws:s3:::bluewave-staging-samples). Our infra lead (cc: Rajiv) will create an IAM role that you can assume for ingestion. Expect that file by EOD today.

- Retention: For the pilot keep data for 30 days; after that we run automatic lifecycle to Glacier unless otherwise requested. We do not anticipate EU residency requirements for this pilot — US-only.

- Volume: Initial pilot traffic: ~15 concurrent users, ~2k tokens/session average; monthly pilot usage estimate ~9M tokens. We can revisit after the first two weeks.

- Model: We prefer starting on a smaller quantized variant for the pilot to validate flows, then flip to the larger model for acceptance tests. If Redwood recommends a specific quantization profile, please advise.

- SOW/DocuSign: I received the DocuSign link and routed to procurement — Rajiv will sign once we confirm the kickoff timeline.

Attachments I’ll drop on the thread: BlueWave-staging-architecture.png (network diagram), and a brief onboarding checklist.

Looking forward to the kickoff on 12/06.
